subject: Ringfence demo slot & confirm stakeholder owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ringfence demo slot & confirm stakeholder owners

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (very short):
- Problem: Atlas has unpredictable inference latency on peak load for the patient summarization pipeline.
- Goal: validate whether Redwood Dedicated or a private deployment reduces 99th-percentile latency below 200ms while keeping costs in budget.
- Ok to proceed to a 60–75 minute technical deep dive/demo with platform/security and procurement present.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Option A: Thu, May 13 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Option B: Fri, May 14 — 2:00–3:15pm PT

Can you ringfence Option A for now? If procurement or security have constraints we can pivot. Please loop in the platform/security/procurement owners (I cc'd common folks on our side below).

Internal owners:
- Marissa Cole will lead the platform/technical walkthrough (benchmarks, KV cache behavior, batching).
- Sean Gallagher will own procurement/contract path and next-step cadence.
- Karthik Iyer will support SSO/infra questions and bring sample infra diagrams if helpful.

Ask for you/your team before the meeting:
- Share any SSO/SAML / SCIM requirements (even a brief doc or internal link).
- Any specific test inputs or sequence lengths we should include in the demo.

I attached a short draft agenda and a stub SSO checklist to make it easier for your security/procurement to review ahead of time. If Option A works for you, I’ll send an invite and copy everyone.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Ben — great summary, thanks. Option A (Thu May 13 10am PT) looks preferable from our side. Procurement needs an AM slot if possible so that aligns. Looping in two owners from my side: 
- Priya Shah (Procurement) — priya.shah@atlashealth.com
- Rajiv Menon (Security) — rajiv.menon@atlashealth.com

Priya/Rajiv: we want the demo to cover SSO and data handling (no PHI will be sent in the demo, but we do want to confirm retention and audit log behavior).

Two quick asks from Atlas before the call:
1) Can Redwood confirm whether you support SP-initiated SAML and JIT user provisioning?
2) Can you share a one-page summary of how audit logs surface per-tenant (we need that for our security intake)?

I attached a short internal note outlining our procurement timeline (informal). Option A works for now — please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Liam / Priya / Rajiv — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping in your colleagues. Confirming: we will hold Thu, May 13 at 10:00am PT and I will send a calendar invite momentarily.

Quick answers to the asks: 
- SP-initiated SAML: yes, Redwood supports both SP and IdP initiated SAML flows. We also support SCIM for provisioning (limited attributes by default; can map additional claims).
- Audit logs: we expose per-tenant audit logs with token-level events and a downloadable CSV/JSON export. I'll drop a one-page summary to the Drive link below.

Pre-reads I added to the shared drive link:
1) SSO_requirements_stub.pdf — a short checklist for common SAML/SCIM items.
2) redwood_demo_agenda_v1.docx — proposed walkthrough + optional load test segment.
3) audit_log_onepager.pdf — how audit data is surfaced and retention options.

Internal owners on our side (for clarity):
- Marissa — will lead the demo and cover performance tuning and KV cache behavior.
- Sean — will sync directly with Priya on procurement path and commercial questions; I'll let you coordinate pricing cadence.
- Karthik — will handle any infra/SSO deep questions and can bring a sample VPC diagram if helpful.

Ben will send the invite and include a link to a short pre-demo questionnaire (1–2 items) so Marissa can tailor the session. If there's anything else you want covered, call it out in reply or drop it into the Drive doc.

Invite: TBD (will follow).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
